name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: The latest available Sol or Astra declares solo, delegate, audit, or exceptional full delivery before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with the latest available Sol or Astra, declare a risk-gated route, and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor uses the latest available high-capability Sol or Astra model in the primary session without pinning a model generation, with high reasoning preferred and medium or higher supported, for architecture, implementation when solo or audit is selected, verification, and acceptance. Missing primary model or effort metadata does not require user confirmation; an observed non-Sol/non-Astra model or effort below medium stops delegation. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-6 Luna / Max for bounded work or GPT-5.6 Terra / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6.1 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
